# GENERATED by cargo-arael: build glue for the `Path` model interface. Do not edit.

#
# Consumer usage:
#   add_subdirectory(path/to/cxx)        # or FetchContent
#   target_link_libraries(app PRIVATE arael::slam_demo_gm)
#
# Requires a Rust toolchain (cargo builds the capi staticlib; cargo is
# its own dependency tracker, so the custom target always runs and
# no-ops when nothing changed).
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16)

if(CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR STREQUAL CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR)
  project(slam_demo_gm_capi NONE)
endif()

set(_arael_capi_dir "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../capi")
set(_arael_cargo_target "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/cargo")
set(_arael_capi_lib "${_arael_cargo_target}/release/libslam_demo_gm_capi.a")

# The GPU runtime the interface is built with, for SparseOptions::gpu:
# cuda, hip, cpu (the CPU device), or empty for none.
set(ARAEL_GPU "" CACHE STRING "GPU runtime of the arael interface: cuda, hip, cpu or empty")
set(_arael_features "")
if(ARAEL_GPU STREQUAL "cuda" OR ARAEL_GPU STREQUAL "hip" OR ARAEL_GPU STREQUAL "cpu")
  set(_arael_features --features gpu-${ARAEL_GPU})
elseif(NOT ARAEL_GPU STREQUAL "")
  message(FATAL_ERROR "ARAEL_GPU is '${ARAEL_GPU}': cuda, hip, cpu or empty")
endif()

add_custom_target(slam_demo_gm_capi_build
  COMMAND cargo build --release ${_arael_features}
          --manifest-path "${_arael_capi_dir}/Cargo.toml"
          --target-dir "${_arael_cargo_target}"
  BYPRODUCTS "${_arael_capi_lib}"
  VERBATIM)

add_library(arael_slam_demo_gm STATIC IMPORTED GLOBAL)
set_target_properties(arael_slam_demo_gm PROPERTIES
  IMPORTED_LOCATION "${_arael_capi_lib}"
  INTERFACE_INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/include")
if(UNIX)
  set_property(TARGET arael_slam_demo_gm APPEND PROPERTY
    INTERFACE_LINK_LIBRARIES pthread dl m)
endif()
# Keep the staticlib's symbols inside whatever links it. Exported from a
# shared library, the asm routines faer uses on x86-64 (private-gemm-x86)
# call one another through lazily bound PLT slots, which they do not survive.
if(UNIX AND NOT APPLE)
  set_property(TARGET arael_slam_demo_gm APPEND PROPERTY
    INTERFACE_LINK_OPTIONS "LINKER:--exclude-libs,libslam_demo_gm_capi.a")
endif()
add_dependencies(arael_slam_demo_gm slam_demo_gm_capi_build)
add_library(arael::slam_demo_gm ALIAS arael_slam_demo_gm)
